title: Cross-View Attention Fusion Net: A Prior-Guided Dual-View Representation Learning for Cardiac Output Estimation from Short-Term PPG Signals
abstract: arXiv:2605.19666v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Accurate cardiac output (CO) estimation from photoplethysmography (PPG) is promising for unobtrusive hemodynamic monitoring, but remains difficult since CO is jointly determined by cardiac function and vascular tone. Conventional feature-based models use physiologically meaningful PPG descriptors, yet depend on accurate pulse detection and may miss latent temporal relationships. In contrast, fully end-to-end deep learning models learn directly from raw PPG but often underuse established PPG-derived prior information. Here, we introduce the Cross-View Attention Fusion Network (CVAF-Net), a prior-guided dual-view deep learning model for CO estimation from short, fixed-length PPG segments. CVAF-Net processes raw PPG as a temporal view and a feature sequence map (FSM) as a structured prior-guided view, and fuses the two representations through cross-view attention. The model was independently evaluated using 5-, 15-, and 30-s segme

translated_title: 跨视图注意力融合网络：一种用于从短期PPG信号估计心输出量的先验引导双视图表示学习
translated_abstract: 基于光电容积脉搏波（PPG）准确估计心输出量（CO）对于无创血流动力学监测具有重要意义，但由于心输出量由心脏功能和血管张力共同决定，该任务仍然具有挑战性。传统的基于特征的模型使用具有生理意义的PPG描述符，但依赖于准确的脉搏检测，且可能遗漏潜在的时间关系。相比之下，完全端到端的深度学习模型直接从原始PPG中学习，但往往未能充分利用已有的PPG衍生先验信息。本文提出了跨视图注意力融合网络（CVAF-Net），这是一种先验引导的双视图深度学习模型，用于从短的固定长度PPG片段中估计心输出量。CVAF-Net将原始PPG作为时间视图处理，将特征序列图（FSM）作为结构化的先验引导视图，并通过跨视图注意力机制融合这两种表示。该模型分别使用5秒、15秒和30秒的片段进行了独立评估。
tldr: 提出跨视图注意力融合网络CVAF-Net，通过跨视图注意力将原始PPG的时间视图与特征序列图的先验引导视图相融合，实现从短期PPG信号准确估计心输出量。
en_tdlr: CVAF-Net is a prior-guided dual-view deep learning model that fuses raw PPG temporal representations with structured feature sequence maps via cross-view attention to achieve accurate cardiac output estimation from short-term PPG signals.
